verdict.pick: Pet Gear No‑Zip Expedition Pet Stroller (150 lbs)
verdict.line: Picture a senior dog who can no longer walk due to arthritis. The Pet Gear No‑Zip Expedition lets him move comfortably on rough trails with a sturdy steel chassis and airless EVA tires. It is the only stroller in this guide that supports up to 150 lb and has dual entry for easy loading.
